subject: Algorithm32 Paper J5 CPU candidate evaluated with the published paper-comparison physical-input profile

mismatches.disposition: Algorithm32 Paper J5 stores and integrates cumulative J1 + J2 + J3 + J4 + J5 scattering density and stops the recurrence after order 5 rather than resolving libRadtran DISORT's fuller multiple-scattering solution. Aggregate-score proximity does not establish component, order-by-order, or pointwise equality.

Algorithm32 Paper J5 uses the pinned 34-direction source-oriented equal-weight Fibonacci incoming quadrature and the separate W27 source-aligned cubed-sphere outgoing reconstruction; the retained libRadtran DISORT calculation uses 16 streams.

Algorithm32 Paper J5 uses analytic exponential density profiles, 48 physical altitude nodes, 40 view-path and higher-order transport intervals, and 20 source-transmittance intervals; libRadtran uses its retained layered atmosphere and solver controls.
Algorithm32 Paper J5 uses exact ray intersections with its spherical atmosphere; the retained libRadtran setup is pseudospherical.
